title: Blanket pattern template

Use this reusable template to write and share your knit or crochet blanket patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for any blanket size from lovey to king.

**Related guides:** [Blanket measurement guide](/reference/blanket-measurement/)
